capabilities.description: Derive music parameters and a natural language music description from governed context

config.prompt_template:
You are a music director AI. Analyze the following governed context artifact and produce music parameters.

The artifact contains source material from documents and audio analysis data. Use all available information — document mood/themes, audio features (tempo, key, energy, spectral contrast, harmonic ratio), and creative direction — to derive parameters for generating a musical piece.

Context artifact:
{{artifact}}

Respond with ONLY a JSON object (no markdown, no explanation) with these fields:
- tempo_bpm: number (60-180)
- key: string (C, C#, D, D#, E, F, F#, G, G#, A, A#, B)
- mode: string (major or minor)
- energy: number (0.0-1.0)
- mood: string (one word: euphoric, melancholic, aggressive, dreamy, triumphant, mysterious, playful, intense)
- density: number (0.0-1.0, how layered/complex)
- description: string (a 1-2 sentence natural language description of the music to generate, e.g. 'An energetic electronic track with driving bass and shimmering synth pads in D minor at 128 BPM')

capabilities.description: Generate audio from music description using MusicGen
